Hi Jordan / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at FluxHealth is aligned on scope. We reviewed the mutual action plan and put together an internal calendar: procurement needs a 72-hr review on the SOW before our CFO signs, and IT needs the private deployment checklist done. Can you confirm the absolute latest date you need our countersigned SOW to make a 1 May start realistic?

I've attached our redlines (SOW_FluxHealth_v3.pdf) and the MAP we've been editing (MAP_FluxHealth_Q2.xlsx).

- Confirm signatory timeline (procurement + CFO)
- Any outstanding items that would block the May 1 start
- Whether Redwood can accept a small change request on the data retention clause (section 4.2) — our legal is asking for a 60-day retention exception for test logs

Can we aim for a short call Monday to lock the plan?

Best,
Sara
Sr. Program Manager
FluxHealth

Sara — thanks for the clear note and the files. Short answers up front:
- Absolute latest for countersigned SOW to keep a May 1 onramp: April 16 (we need two weeks to provision dedicated capacity + run preflight compliance checks).
- Blockers: the data retention exception in 4.2 needs legal review; also we need the network allowlist details at least 7 business days before start.
- We can accept a limited 60-day test-log retention on a temporary basis if IT signs off; we should scope that as a timeboxed exception in the SOW (we'll add an appendix).

Looping in Naomi (security/compliance) and Ben (customer success/ops) to confirm the nitty-gritty and schedule a short call Monday 15 March at 10:00 PT if that works. If not, propose alternatives.

Short call agenda proposal (15 min):
1) Confirm countersign target and routing
2) Data retention exception (scope + sunset)
3) Network allowlist + start slot (May 1 viability)
4) DocuSign path + signer windows

—Jordan

Jordan / Karthik — I reviewed the redline on 4.2. We can provisionally accept a 60-day retention for test logs under the following controls:
- Exception is timeboxed to the pilot period only and automatically reverts to standard retention at pilot close
- Logs must be encrypted at rest and accessible only to named FluxHealth contacts
- No production PII may be stored in test logs; if PII is present it must be redacted before ingestion

If those conditions are agreeable, I can draft an appendix and circulate it for countersignature. From an ops timeline perspective, allowinglist + KMS key details are required by Apr 20 to meet a May 1 start (provision + verification steps).

Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
